snippet.title: Biped 2 Release Date Trailer | November 5
snippet.description: META Publishing, an Owlcat Games publishing label, has announced the release date for Biped 2, the sequel to the highly praised co-op adventure beloved by players worldwide. Winner of the 2025 Game Connection Indie Game of the Year, Biped 2 will launch on November 5 for Windows PC via Steam, GOG, and the Epic Games Store, as well as on PlayStation 4 and 5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and Series X|S.
